title: Two 'Well done' notes to single members silence the phone pop-up of the gym's big notice later that day
what: On Training progress the owner can send 'Well done' or 'How's it going?' to one member. Each one counts toward the gym's limit of 2 phone pop-ups a day for the whole gym. After two such one-person notes, every later message that day, including a notice or offer to all members, lands in the app with no pop-up. Nothing on Training progress warns that a one-person note uses up the gym's allowance.
expected: A note to one member should not use up the pop-up allowance meant for notices to everyone, or the owner should be told before sending that it will.
how_often: any day the owner cheers two members before a notice
fix_line: Count only notices to many members toward the 2 a day, or warn on Training progress before sending.

title: Member questions promise a phone notification with every reply
what: The Member questions page says the reply shows in the member's app with a notification on their phone. The pop-up only arrives when the member still has the app, gave a push address, allowed notifications, and the phone maker's battery rules let it through. The owner is never told when it did not go.
expected: Say the reply is always in their app and pops up on their phone when notifications are on.
fix_line: Soften the line to: pops up on their phone when notifications are on.

title: A booked or cancelled personal-training session is never told to the member
what: On Trainers the owner or desk books a session or cancels one. The screen only shows 'Booking cancelled.' to the person at the desk. No phone pop-up, no in-app note and no ready WhatsApp goes to the member; the server has no kind of member pop-up for bookings. A member can arrive for a session that was cancelled, or not know one was booked.
expected: Booking and cancelling should tell the member (a pop-up in their app, or a ready WhatsApp the desk can send).
how_often: every booking and cancel, once trainer pages go live
fix_line: Send a member pop-up on book and cancel, or open a ready WhatsApp after each.
